segments.text: Hello, Officer Ferry Ridgewater, please. The reason I stopped you, you're a 59 and a 45. Do you have your registration and insurance with you?
Pardon me? That one's expired as of September.

Okay, well, the requirement is that you provide, and I'm giving you an opportunity to do so. So if you want to refuse to give me one, that's okay, but I'm giving you the opportunity. Why are you being a jerk? I haven't been. I'm not. You are. You've stated three times, I don't know, sarcastically, okay? I really don't know. I requested something that you're required to give me, okay? And I'm giving you the opportunity to give you it. I am not being sarcastic with you. I have been nice to you. What I'm trying to explain to you is I'm giving you the opportunity to look for it.

Oh my gosh, you're the first one who's asked me for this. What's your name? My name's Officer Fager with the Edgewater Police Department. Spell your name for me. It'll be on the bottom of the citation. You're an asshole. Do you have your insurance, ma'am?
Yeah, it's on my phone. You want that, too? Yes, ma'am.
